metadata.algorithm: 1-site: exact evaluation of every screened road anchor. 2/3-site: deterministic forward greedy addition; each stage evaluates every spacing-eligible anchor.

objectives.robust: maximize number of Robust Top 20 meshes with shorter distance, then their median reduction
